mechanism_narrative: The four-week slide in RETAIL_REC is decelerating, with week-on-week steps of -9.8, -6.2 and -4.0 points, so the marginal weekly drop over the next 28 days is smaller than over the last 28 days and mechanically raises the next-28-day mean above -28.05.
failure_condition: The next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is at or below -28.05, i.e. the weekly decline re-accelerates instead of flattening.

mechanism_narrative: Transit usage parked below -40 percent for two consecutive weeks signals that discretionary trip-making remains legally or practically constrained, so retail footfall keeps eroding and the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean falls below the last-28-day mean.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT closes two consecutive weeks below -40 percent
failure_condition: Following any two-week stretch with TRANSIT below -40, the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean exceeds -28.05.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL above +10 combined with WORKPLACES below -25 keeps households anchored in their home catchment; local errands substitute for mall and dining trips, so aggregate retail-and-recreation footfall stays depressed over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL at or above +10 and WORKPLACES at or below -25 in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL sits at +15.7 while WORKPLACES sits at -29.4
failure_condition: In weeks where RESIDENTIAL >= +10 and WORKPLACES <= -25 jointly hold, the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean is above -28.05.

mechanism_narrative: A deepening negative in GROCERY_PHARM is the canonical pre-restriction stockpiling signature; when it worsens by more than five points over two weeks, containment measures follow within roughly 14 days and drag RETAIL_REC further down over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM worsens by more than 5 points across any two-week window
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM moved from -0.6 to -10.9 over three weeks
failure_condition: After a >5-point two-week deterioration in GROCERY_PHARM, the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean is at or above -28.05.

mechanism_narrative: The one-week improvement in GROCERY_PHARM from -10.9 to -9.0 marks the end of the stockpiling burst; depleted pantries redirect spending back into retail and recreation channels, lifting the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean above -28.05.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises week-on-week by at least 1 point
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rose from -10.9 to -9.0 in the final week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean falls to or below -28.05 in the four weeks after GROCERY_PHARM posts a week-on-week improvement.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS readings near -30 in mid-January reflect deep-winter outdoor avoidance that persists through mid-February, removing an ambient outdoor-traffic stimulus that normally spills into retail strips, so RETAIL_REC stays below its last-28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS declined every week from -21.7 to -29.7
failure_condition: The next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean exceeds -28.05 while PARKS remains at or below -20 throughout the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: The rebound in WORKPLACES from its -50.0 trough to -29.4 signals restored commuting routines; retail and recreation footfall tracks commuting with a roughly two-week lag, so RETAIL_REC recovers within the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES improves by at least 10 points from its trailing four-week trough
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose from -50.0 to -29.4 in two weeks
failure_condition: WORKPLACES holds above -35 for two consecutive weeks while the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean stays at or below -28.05.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL easing from +19.9 to +15.7 together with TRANSIT holding near -45 means trip substitution back toward transit is starting; the joint release of pent-up demand lifts RETAIL_REC within one week rather than four.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below +16 and TRANSIT rises above -47 in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL eased from +19.9 to +15.7 while TRANSIT moved from -49.3 to -46.0
failure_condition: In weeks where RESIDENTIAL < +16 and TRANSIT > -47 jointly hold, the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean is not above -28.05.
